title: Lisbon, at a human pace

cover.subtitle: Seven days built around late mornings, one serious cultural anchor per day, and room to wander.

thesis: A week in Lisbon with enough structure to protect the good parts of the day and enough slack for the city to interrupt the plan.

known_preferences: Good food without formal ceremony every night
One substantial cultural anchor per day
constraints: Do not turn every day into a timed route
